# Hosea Chapter 9 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 332r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/HOS_009_page_001.jpg

---

## Consensus Translation

**9:1** Do-not rejoice al-tismach, Yisra'el, to-exultation el-gil like-the-peoples; for you-have-played-the-harlot zanita from your-God me'al elohekha; you-have-loved ahavta a-prostitute's-wage etnan on all threshing-floors gornot of-grain dagan.

**9:7** The-days of-visitation ha-peqqudah have-come ba'u, the-days of-recompense ha-shillum have-come; let-Yisra'el know yede'u! The-prophet ha-navi is a-fool evil, the-man of-the-spirit ish ha-ruach is mad meshugga — because-of the-greatness rov of-your-iniquity avonekha and-great rabbah is the-hostility mastemah.

**9:10** Like-grapes ka-anavim in-the-wilderness ba-midbar I-found matsati Yisra'el; like-a-first-fruit ke-vikkurah on-a-fig-tree bi-te'enah in-its-first-season be-re'shitah I-saw ra'iti your-fathers avoteikhem. They came to-Ba'al-Pe'or Baal-Peor and-consecrated-themselves vayyinnazru to-shame la-boshet, and-became-detestable vayyihyu shiqqutism like-the-thing-they-loved ke-ohavam.

---
## SOPHIA's Council Notes

Hosea 9 — "Punishment for Israel" — continues the book's distinctive blend of personal biography and national theology. The marriage metaphor that structures the entire book gives Hosea an emotional intensity unmatched in the prophetic corpus.

---
## Disagreement Log

This chapter produced minor register disagreements resolved through SOPHIA's standard consensus process.
